Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && grep -R "fuzz_disasmnext" -n suite/fuzz . | head -20 && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
os.makedirs('/tmp/corpus', exist_ok=True)
for n in z.namelist()[1:6]:
    p='/tmp/corpus/'+os.path.basename(n)
    open(p,'wb').write(z.read(n))
    print(p)
PY
./build/fuzz_disasm /tmp/corpus/* 2>&1 | head -80
